spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Know, beloved, that when the corrupted receptacles were forced open and emptied, the separation was accomplished through a violent upheaval in the lowest degree; yet what was expelled was taken out from within the corrupted powers themselves.

It is as with a person whose spiritual form has been seized by a foul corruption: many disordered evils and falsities spread through the outward life, and even more poisonous persuasions infest the inmost faculties. That person is restored by wisdom acting with skill: one influx is given that brings the hidden corruption up into open manifestation, another influx is given that drives what must be cast out down and away into the lowest level, and yet another influx is given that heals the remaining disorders and settles the life into quiet order.

By such intelligent government, living operations remove evils in this way and dissolve compulsions of deceptive persuasion; the restoring powers work even by a gentle perception of what is salutary. What was concealed is uncovered; the rooted falsities are finally torn out when they have been brought into outer visibility above and below through an inwardly received healing influence.

So it is with the three chief corruptions concealed within the interior life of the dominant falsifying powers in higher states. The Divine saving operation is present as wisdom itself, and it applies a threefold mode of healing by assuming accommodated outer forms for reception: clarifying discernment, living truth, and purifying love. By these, the lower realm was arranged into order. Through this accommodated manifestation the dominant powers were thrown into hardness, trembling, fear, and derangement, and by that exposure the three corruptions were expelled from them: falsified truth, active denial, and perverted love.

The state of these corruptions is like nascent spiritual life enclosed within successive coverings: first an inmost support of life, then a fixed framework of principles, then connective powers, then the general substance of acquired life, then channels of communication, then circulating vitality, and finally an outermost boundary that contains and protects. Beyond these are further encompassing supports from the surrounding matrix that carries what is forming. In all these ultimates together the living essence is interwoven and held.

When the foul pressure of infernal operation that induces the anguish of emergence makes what is within ready to be revealed, the restraints yield in ordered fashion, and the new life comes forth by an opening made perceptible, without injury to its form. As nascent life thus opens what contained it and is brought forth, so it was with those three corruptions: the operations that opened their containment and shook them out into manifestation were the same three living accommodated forms assumed by the Divine saving operation.

By the manifestation of living truth, the deadly falsification was drawn out from the dominant powers—those poisonous persuasions with which their communications and inner affections had been filled.

By the manifestation of clarifying discernment, the whole destructive obscurity and defilement was swept away and erased, driven down into the lowest natural degree; afterwards it was gathered from that level and confined in a fixed general boundary of denial and obscurity that encompasses the external order.

By the manifestation of living love, through its brightness and power, the infernal ardor of perverted love was expelled from the dominant powers and cast down into the lowest degree; then it was gathered again from that level and confined in an encompassing ultimate restraint around all states, experienced as a severe boundary of consuming lust.

These three accommodated forms, by which the separations were effected, were not withdrawn all at once; they were removed successively in due order and at the fitting time, as each lower arrangement was secured in its place.

Thus the organized totality of the lower realm was preserved, and the expelled corruptions were held in fixed limits like bonds and measures.

The governance of these expelled corruptions—driven out from higher states into the lowest degree, and afterwards gathered from the lowest and thrust outward to the extremity—produced a fullness of great uses.

The first use was that evil-doing might not increase without measure in the whole system, neither in formed communities nor in the perceptions and works that grow within them, because the tendency to evil had set itself up in a triad of corrupt forces.

The first of these is the lust itself.

The second is pervasive error among the dominant powers: if falsified truth had not been cast down, but the falsities in those powers had remained, continual streams of persuasive falsity would have flowed downward and subtle insinuations would have descended, and lust would have sprung up in perverted perceptions, in the works that proceed from them, and in every affection of embodied life. In such a state scarcely any holiness could be preserved in anyone in the whole order, nor could anyone become master over these assaults.

And further: if active denial and obscurity had not been expelled and first driven into the lowest degree and then thrust outside the ordered region into its fixed abyss, continual insinuations of darkness would have descended and streams of denial would have kept flowing down into the lowest life, seizing perverted perceptions and every embodied affection. Forgetfulness of the Divine would have multiplied so greatly that what is now scattered among many would be found concentrated in one, and scarcely anyone would retain the thought and knowledge of the Divine.

Moreover: if perverted love had remained in the dominant powers of the higher states until now, and had not been expelled, cast down, and then shut up within the encompassing restraint that surrounds all ordered states, its fury would have poured down from above and surged up from below.

Then the infernal ardor of that love would have multiplied in perverted perception, in the works born of it, and in every embodied affection, so that the intensity now distributed among many would rage in a single person.

See, you have been taught about this single compound evil that was purified by a triad of governing confirmations.

The second use was that the higher states were cleansed of remaining dregs and defilements, so that what is pure might prevail there.

The third use was that the intermediate ordered structures joining higher and lower were relieved from oppressive burdens and enslaving weights, so that their function ceased to be heavy.

The fourth use was that the dwellings of higher life might be purified and cleansed.

The fifth use was that the abundance and richness of capacities gathered into the serving forms of conveyance might be found living there in a purified and holy condition.

The sixth use was that the mixed, incomplete, and unbounded sanctuaries in higher states might come into rest and be purified, for peace would reach them, pass through them, and cleanse them.

The seventh use was that the restrained corruptions, by their own nature pressing toward their allotted places, should not pass beyond the fixed limits set for them.

The eighth use was that strong encompassing boundaries might be established, and everything be held in restraint.

The tenth use was that at the completion of the age they would become means of release and purification for all things that must be separated, by a final consuming removal of what is unclean.

The eleventh use was that a passage would be made for the transfer of souls, and the entire dominion of darkness would be driven outward into the ultimate boundary; for the eternities of light are beyond the lower boundary, in peace, honor, grace, and abiding joy.

The twelfth use was that the works of ruin might be hidden from the eternities of light because of the encompassing ultimate restraint around the whole structure, and that the unclean things appear only in the outermost allotted domain.

These twelve uses were necessary because the expelled corruptions—driven down from higher ordering truths into the lowest degree, and then thrust outward to the extremity—had to be held under vigilant governance. Therefore living truths from the Divine were appointed over them in great power to watch over them to the last time, and for this cause they are fixed firmly in restraints, as in bonds, according to the order declared.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong through the central narrative of threefold Divine operation expelling and confining three corruptions, with consistent movement from higher states to the lowest degree and then to ultimate boundaries. Coherence stumbles where the source is fragmentary: the arithmetic of the coverings, the broken description of the first deed’s substructure, the missing ninth deed, and the damaged closing clause about the appointed guardians. Despite these breaks, the chapter reads largely as a single instructional voice describing orderly restraint and the uses of separation.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate: the chapter teaches by function (healing, discharge, confinement) using organic analogies (doctor/patient; womb/birth) that naturally generate the spiritual sense. No sign of an administrative overlay here; the narrative runs as one continuous process: hidden toxins → manifested/expelled → confined in boundary-vessels.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by what things DO: a “wise doctor” uses “one remedy… causes… break out above… another… discharge below… another… cures” (¶3), then the Living Spirit as doctor uses “three garments… of wind, of water, and of fire” to “discharge the three vessels” (¶5), then birth-analogy explains non-violent emergence “from a crack… while no tear nor wound occurs” (¶7). The spiritual reading largely ‘develops’ without forcing except for minor lexical pressure (“aroma,” ¶4), which is a translation nuance, not a narrative break (Stage 3a notes: “phrasing about ‘aroma’ presses…”).

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from damaged/awkward transmission (repetitions and garbling), not a voice change. The ‘aroma/edible medicines’ line likely reflects textual corruption or dittography; it makes the spiritual reading strain at nuance but does not introduce an alien didactic mode.
findings.evidence: The Coptic is internally tangled: “manifested above and below [and manifested above and below, by the] the aroma…” (¶4) shows repetition; “edible medicines that were placed upon them” is semantically odd in context. The reader flags this as forced (“‘aroma’ presses toward ‘gentle perception’; exact nuance… is forced”). This is a local transmissional problem, not an administrative insertion (no jurisdictions, ranks, named officers, etc.).

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential teaching with a small internal tension: ‘vessels’ are said to be discharged by three ‘garments,’ but the garments listed are wind/water/fire whereas the vessels are water/darkness/fire. This is best explained as ordinary doctrinal compression (wind-as-agent vs darkness-as-product), not a later administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: ¶5: “three healing drugs… three garments… of wind, of water, and of fire… discharged the three vessels… of water, of darkness and of fire.” The reader notes mapping is inferred (“triad… stable but exact doctrinal labels are not explicit”). This is still functional teaching: garments operate as modes that effect discharge, not authorities assigned to territories.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty plus minor expansion/garbling in the arithmetic (7/9/18). The analogy is correspondential (successive membranes/coverings), but the counting is inconsistent and probably disturbed in transmission; the spiritual reading ‘flattens’ the numbers because the text’s arithmetic is not stable.
findings.evidence: ¶6 counts seven bodily ‘garments,’ then adds “The other garment also… total nine,” then “Together with the nine of the child… complete… eighteen garments.” The referents for the extra garments are unclear (“garment that she wears and the linen that swathes her”), and “Together with the nine of the child, these and the others” is syntactically unstable. Reader: “arithmetic of ‘seven, nine, eighteen’… unclear to preserve.” This stumbling arises from corrupt or conflated counting, not from an administrative voice intrusion.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential process-sequence: each garment effects a functional removal/confinement, then the garments are removed in order. The narrative is tight and mechanically consistent (draw out → sweep down → sweep again → confine).
findings.evidence: ¶8–10 each has a functional verb-chain: “drew out… vessel of water” (¶8); “swept away… discharged… Afterwards… confined… vessel of darkness” (¶9); “discharged… threw… swept… confined… wall of great fire” (¶10). ¶11 provides process-order (“not… all at once… one by one”), ¶12 summarizes function (“guarded… like fetters and measures”). The reader’s account flows here without complaint beyond one unclear clause (“he moved [from them]” in ¶8) that is minor damage, not a seam.

findings.diagnosis: Seam introducing a systematizing addendum (“twelve great deeds”) in a more enumerative, governance-flavored mode. This is not fully administrative (no named officers), but it shifts from organic process (doctor/birth/discharge) to benefits-inventory. It reads like a didactic expansion appended to the core correspondential narrative.
findings.evidence: ¶13 pivots: “The use of the matter, and the management of these vessels… have brought an advantage… of twelve great deeds.” The reader flags a ‘SHIFT’ and had to treat “twelve” as ‘fullness’ before the list (“‘Twelve’ is rendered as ‘fullness’; later clauses enumerate”). The very terms “management… advantage… twelve great deeds” mark a mode change from functional imagery to institutionalized enumeration—typical of seam-expansion behavior even without full administrative personnel lists.
findings.scope: "The use of the matter, and the management of these vessels that were swept out and discharged from above to earth, have brought an advantage and benefit of twelve great deeds. Afterwards, they were swept from the earth and pushed outside to the edges of the worlds and to the {extremity}."

findings.diagnosis: Text is damaged and internally inconsistent in its enumeration: it announces “The first deed,” then introduces a different sub-list “three things,” with ¶15 fragmentary (“[The first is lust.]”). The spiritual reading stumbles because the textual scaffolding is broken; it is not primarily an administrative insertion, but a disrupted expansion that cannot keep its own numbering straight.
findings.evidence: ¶14 is broken: “neither in the creations nor in the trees [because]tself up in three things.” Then ¶15 is a bare label: “The [The first is lust.]” Yet ¶16 begins “The second is error…” and develops a counterfactual about the “vessel of water,” and ¶17 treats “vessel of darkness,” ¶18–19 the fire, before ¶20: “single evil… purified by three archetypes [three seals].” The reader repeatedly notes damage/forcing: ¶14 “phrase… is broken,” ¶15 “fragmentary… only a label,” ¶16 “end… damaged,” ¶18 “sentence is incomplete,” ¶20 “archetypes/seals… term is uncertain.” This is exactly how a corrupted enumerative addendum behaves: it tries to impose a threefold schema (“three things,” “three seals”) onto the earlier three-vessel narrative but survives in fragments.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶14–20 as a damaged enumerative expansion (first deed + threefold substructure ‘lust/error/fire’ + ‘three seals’) with broken syntax and uncertain technical terms; do not attempt surgical excision inside the damaged sublist.

findings.diagnosis: Overlay-style inventory of ‘deeds/uses’ in enumerative mode; not administrative-by-personnel, but administrative-by-governance/utility listing. Coherence stumbles especially at numbering discontinuities (missing ninth; duplicated headers), suggesting either loss in transmission or compilation from a list-source. This block likely belongs to the same systematizing addendum introduced at ¶13.
findings.evidence: This section is almost entirely list-headers with abstract benefits: “The second deed… The third… The fourth… The fifth…” etc. It has clear list symptoms: duplicated header in ¶23 (“The fourth… [The fourth:]”), jump from “The eighth” (¶27) to “The tenth” (¶29) with no ninth, and fragmentary wording in ¶22 (“This rich one… set over them”). The reader flags these: ¶22 “badly broken,” ¶23 “repeats the header,” ¶29 “ninth use is absent… numbering jumps.” This is classic overlay/list transmission, not the original organic teaching mode.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶21–27 and ¶29–32 as an enumerative ‘twelve deeds’ overlay list with missing/duplicated items and damaged lines (especially ¶22–23 and the absent ninth), likely appended to the three-vessel correspondential narrative.

findings.diagnosis: Damaged closing seam that introduces administrative personnel (“three words of life watch over them… set over them… appointed”)—a governance move absent from the substrate narrative. The spiritual reading stumbles here because the sentence is corrupted mid-stream, but the surviving content is clearly administrative (appointment of watchers) attached to the vessels-as-fetters idea.
findings.evidence: The paragraph is visibly corrupted: “to the {extr[extremity] the three words of life watch over them that [ar]e set over them in great power [were appointed.]” The reader notes: “heavily corrupted mid-sentence (‘three words of life…’); rendered as ‘living truths… appointed as guardians.’” That is precisely an administrative gesture: appointing overseers “set over them in great power… watch… at the last time,” which is governance language appended to the restraint-mechanism.
findings.scope: "and were also swept from the earth to the {extr[extremity] the three words of life watch over them that [ar]e set over them in great power [were appointed.] that they might watch over them at the last time;"

textual_criticism.summary: Issues found: 6. Clean correspondential substrate confirmed in ¶2–12 (doctor/birth/garments → discharge/confinement). Major stumbling points align with (a) local textual damage/garbling (¶4; ¶6–7 arithmetic; ¶14–20 broken syntax and terms; ¶22; numbering), and (b) a seam where a systematizing enumerative ‘twelve deeds’ addendum begins (¶13 onward). Recommendations: excise 2 seam phrases (¶13; corrupt watcher-appointment clause in ¶33) that disrupt the functional narrative; annotate 2 overlay blocks (¶14–20 as damaged ‘first deed + threefold sublist’; ¶21–27 & ¶29–32 as the enumerative list). No excision recommended within the heavily damaged sublists beyond the clear seams.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Happen you know, my beloved ones, that when these vessels were discharged, they were discharged in [great] slaughter, but those [took out] these vessels from them.

⟨p.107⟩
They are like the form of a man who has fallen into a purulent sickness. Other wounds and diseases are in his body, and even bile and other poisons are in his inner limbs. He achieves good health by a wise doctor, who gives him one remedy to drink that causes his purulent sickness to break out above, and gives him another medicine to drink that causes his sickness to discharge below, and he gives him yet another medicine to drink that cures his wounds for him [and makes him rest] calmly and silently.

Through the skill of a wise doctor, with his effective medicines to consume that take away all sicknesses in this manner and dissolve all magic, the doctors shall [discover] they work cures through the aroma of the medicine, other wounds [remove] what is hidden, they at last tear them out from [the inner limbs] manifested above and below [and manifested above and below, by the] the aroma of edible medicines that were placed upon them.

This is also what these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire are like, which are hidden in the body of all the rulers above; while the Living Spirit is like the wise doctor. These three healing drugs are the three garments that the Living Spirit assumes upon his body: of wind, of water, and of fire. Through them he has set in order the things below. For by those three garments he has been displayed to the rulers who are above, with hard-heartedness, with shaking and fear, with derangement; from them he discharged the three vessels, those of water, of darkness and of fire.

The case of these vessels is just like a child who is in his mother's womb and is swathed by seven garments. The first is the marrow, the second is the bones, the third is the tendons, the fourth is the flesh, the fifth the veins, the sixth the blood, the seventh the skin of the body that covers him. The other garment also [that is upon him] this child. The marrow and the bones, the sinews and flesh, the veins and blood and skin, together with the garment that she wears and the linen that swathes her, total nine. Together with the nine of the child, these and the others, they shall complete and make eighteen garments. Now, you shall find the soul of this child is entwined within all these.

⟨p.108⟩
And look see: When the smell of the action of the demon, which brings about the stench of birth, will reveal the child; immediately [the seven garments] shall [be loosened] all [these things] and it emerges from a crack that has become visible, while no tear nor wound occurs in the body of the child. In the same way as this child opens up the womb of his mother, so is it also with these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire. The actions that open up his mother to the child, and she shakes him out and reveals him; these are the three living garments that the Living Spirit assumed on his body.
For by the aspect of the garment of water [he drew out the vessel of water] from the rulers; he moved [from them,] they are the poison and death with which their veins and entrails are filled.

By the aspect of the garment of wind, in which he was revealed [to the rulers;] he has swept away and erased the entire destructive shadow and dirt, discharged it down to the earth. Afterwards he swept it out and confined it in the vessel of darkness that surrounds the universe.

Also, by the garment of living fire, through its splendour and vigour, he discharged the fire of the darkness from all the rulers and threw it down upon this earth. He swept it another time from the earth and confined it in the vessel that surrounds all the worlds, and they call it the wall of great fire.

Now, those three garments, through which he established these three things, he did not peel them off all at once; but he stripped them off one by one at the appropriate time [when he had cast them] down to the earth [and set each one in its vessel.]
In this way the universe of the [lower world] his vessels [was guarded through] these vessels like [fetters and measures.]
Afterwards, they were swept from the earth and pushed outside to the edges of the worlds and to the {extremity}.
The first deed is this: So that evil-doing does not increase in the universe, neither in the creations nor in the trees [because]tself up in three things.
The [The first is lust.]

The second is error [in the rulers above.] Indeed, about this I have spoken to you as I [saying,] For, if it were so, if [the vessel of water] had not been swept down from above, but rather the waters existing up till now in the rulers above [the] torrents that would flow [from above;] and the droplets that would [drip] down, so lust would have sprouted [up]n the trees and in the fruits as well as all flesh [in] down [till]oday [and] you could not find a single person [holy,] in the [whole world;] a saint does [if] is master of [them.]
